name: Exp_RSIOMA
summary: Exp_RSIOMA is an Expert Advisor that trades based on the RSIOMA (RSI of Moving Average) indicator, which applies RSI calculation to a moving average rather than raw price. It generates buy and sell signals when the RSIOMA crosses configurable overbought/oversold threshold levels, combining momentum analysis with smoothed trend filtering for more stable signal generation.
summary_zh: Exp_RSIOMA是一个基于RSIOMA（移动平均线的RSI）指标的EA交易系统，它对移动平均线而非原始价格应用RSI计算。当RSIOMA穿越可配置的超买/超卖阈值水平时产生买入和卖出信号，将动量分析与平滑趋势过滤相结合，以实现更稳定的信号生成。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是RSIOMA指标，即对移动平均线计算RSI值，相比传统RSI能更好地过滤噪音信号。入场条件为：当RSIOMA从超卖区域上穿时做多，从超买区域下穿时做空，具体阈值由参数控制。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈，以及RSIOMA反向交叉信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有动态仓位调整或资金管理算法。资金管理方面较为简单，依赖用户手动设置合理的仓位大小，缺乏基于账户权益或风险的自动计算。整体策略属于动量反转类型，在趋势启动初期捕捉方向性机会，但在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is the RSIOMA indicator, which calculates RSI values on a moving average rather than raw price, providing better noise filtering compared to traditional RSI. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSIOMA crosses upward from the oversold zone and a sell when it crosses downward from the overbought zone, with threshold levels controlled by configurable parameters. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, as well as position closing triggered by RSIOMA reverse crossover signals. Position sizing employs a fixed lot approach without dynamic position adjustment or money management algorithms. Money management is relatively simple, relying on the user to manually set reasonable position sizes, lacking automatic calculation based on account equity or risk percentage. The overall strategy falls into the momentum-reversal category, capturing directional opportunities at the early stage of trend initiation, but may generate more false signals in choppy markets.

parameters.name: RSIOMA_MaPeriod
parameters.description: RSIOMA所基于的移动平均线周期

parameters.name: RSIOMA_MaMethod
parameters.description: 移动平均线的计算方法（简单/指数/加权等）

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

pros: RSIOMA指标对移动平均线计算RSI，有效过滤短期价格噪音，信号更加稳定可靠
策略逻辑清晰简洁，参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境灵活调整阈值
基于动量反转原理，在趋势初期入场具有较好的盈亏比潜力
pros_en: RSIOMA applies RSI to a moving average, effectively filtering short-term price noise for more stable and reliable signals
Clear and concise strategy logic with highly configurable parameters, allowing users to flexibly adjust thresholds for different instruments and market conditions
Based on momentum-reversal principles, entering at trend inception offers good risk-reward ratio potential
cons: 缺乏动态仓位管理和资金管理机制，无法根据账户风险自动调整手数
止损止盈默认为0，存在不设止损的风险，可能导致大幅亏损
在震荡行情中RSIOMA可能频繁穿越阈值产生虚假信号，缺少趋势过滤器或震荡市识别机制
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing and money management mechanisms, unable to automatically adjust lot size based on account risk
Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, posing risk of no stop-loss being set which could lead to significant losses
RSIOMA may frequently cross threshold levels in choppy markets generating false signals, lacking a trend filter or ranging market identification mechanism
improvements: 增加基于账户权益百分比或ATR的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数方式
加入趋势过滤器（如更高周期MA方向判断），减少震荡市中的虚假信号
添加新K线检查机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage or ATR to replace the fixed lot approach
Incorporate a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction confirmation) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Add a new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated position opening within the same candle

risk_points: 止损止盈默认为0，用户可能遗忘设置导致无限亏损风险
缺少新K线检查，可能在同一K线内多次开仓造成过度交易
无持仓检查可能导致同方向重复建仓放大风险
risk_points_en: Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, users may forget to set them leading to unlimited loss risk
Lacks new bar check, potentially opening multiple positions within the same candle causing overtrading
No position check may lead to duplicate positions in the same direction amplifying risk

It generates buy and sell signals when the RSIOMA crosses configurable overbought/oversold threshold levels, combining momentum analysis with smoothed trend filtering for more stable signal generation.
